headline: Non-public session on matters that could harm a person's reputation, under RSA 91-A:3 II (c).
summary: The meeting will move into non-public session on matters that could harm a person's reputation. It will then end that session.
items: Motion to enter non-public session under RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters that could harm a person's reputation if discussed in public (roll call required)
Motion to end the non-public session
location: 3rd Floor Conference Room, SAU District Office, 20 Hecker Street
plain_text:
AGENDA 
 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
COMMITTEE ON STUDENT CONDUCT 
 
August 17, 2026 4:00 p.m.  
Committee Members Hamer, Want, Bergeron, SAU District Office  
St. John and Stewart 
Alternates:  Taylor and Smith 
20 Hecker Street  
3rd Floor Conference Room 
 
To attend:  Hamer, Want, Stewart, St. John and Taylor. 
  
 
1. Chairman Hamer calls the meeting to order.   
 
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
 
3. A motion is in order to enter into non-public session under the provisions of 
RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters, which if discussed in public, would likely affect adversely the reputation 
of any person.  
 
A Roll call is required on the motion.  
 
 
4. A motion is in order to end the non-public session.  
 
 
5. If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Statement of nondiscrimination:  It is the policy of the Manchester Board of School Committee, in its actions, and those of its employees, that there shall be no 
discrimination on the basis of age, sex, race, color, marital status, physical or mental disability, religious creed, national origin or sexual orientation for employment in, 
or operation and administration of any program or activity in the Manchester School District.  The Title IX Coordinator is Dr. Kelly Espinola for staff and students. 
 
 
Per the Strategic Plan, our Mission objective is to provide a transformational learning experience and ensure that every MSD learner has high 
quality postsecondary options to attain a technical certificate, gainful employment, and/or a two-year or four-year degree.
